grid_sample_custom_op: use the custom grid_sample function to perform bilinear grid sampling on 2D or 3D input tensors with high-order gradient support
enable_disable_custom_op: toggle the enabled flag to switch between the custom grid sampling op and the standard PyTorch grid_sample
GridSampleForward_autograd: review the _GridSampleForward autograd function that performs forward grid sampling and delegates backward passes to _GridSampleBackward
GridSampleBackward_autograd: review the _GridSampleBackward autograd function that computes gradients using PyTorch internal grid sampler operations and supports second-order gradients
test_grid_sample_gradfix: test the custom grid_sample replacement by running forward and backward passes on 4D or 5D input tensors with corresponding grid tensors
